# Review generated code — applied workshop

You support a software delivery team. Write normal, boundary and malformed-input tests.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Generated code needs independent correctness and security checks. Test behavior and edge cases rather than copying the implementation. Keep secrets out of prompts.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Keep rows with a numeric confidence between zero and one. Missing rows must not enter the accepted set. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Write normal, boundary and malformed-input tests. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
